summary: The AI Act Scientific Panel is a group of experts tasked with reviewing the European Union’s proposed AI regulations and providing evidence‑based guidance to lawmakers. title: Draft Standardisation Request

summary: The document shows a graphic that explains how a community of practice (CoP) drafts and revises its policy documents. It outlines a cycle of proposing, reviewing, revising, and finalizing text so that ideas can be continually improved through teamwork.

summary: This document shows a graphic timeline that maps out the steps involved in drafting the CoP (Community of Practice) policy. It highlights the main milestones and their dates, giving participants a clear visual guide to the drafting process.

title: Code of Practice: 1st Draft
summary: The document outlines a draft set of guidelines for responsible AI development and use. It provides principles, best practices, and compliance requirements that organizations should follow to promote transparency, safety, and accountability in AI systems.

title: Code of Practice: 2nd Draft
summary: This document outlines a set of guidelines and best practices for the responsible development, deployment, and use of AI systems, aiming to ensure ethical conduct and compliance with relevant regulations. It provides detailed procedures, risk assessment frameworks, and accountability measures to help organizations implement AI solutions safely and transparently.

title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: The Code of Practice: 3rd Draft outlines the standards and responsibilities for developing and deploying artificial intelligence systems, focusing on safety, transparency, and fairness. It provides detailed guidelines for organizations to follow, aiming to ensure ethical use and mitigate risks associated with AI technologies.

title: AI Pact Draft
summary: The AI Pact Draft outlines a collaborative agreement among stakeholders to establish shared principles and guidelines for the responsible development and deployment of artificial intelligence. It aims to promote transparency, safety, and ethical considerations while fostering cooperation between governments, industry, and civil society.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final is a comprehensive agreement that outlines guidelines for the responsible use of artificial intelligence. It establishes standards for transparency, accountability, and ethical considerations to ensure AI benefits society while mitigating risks.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: This policy explains which AI practices are prohibited, such as deceptive manipulation, privacy violations, or the creation of harmful content. It aims to guide developers and users in avoiding unethical AI behavior and promoting safer technology.

title: Guidelines on AI System Definition
summary: This document offers clear criteria for what counts as an AI system, guiding organizations in identifying and classifying such technologies. It outlines key characteristics, scope, and examples to promote consistent understanding and compliance across projects.

title: Communication on Boosting Start-Ups & Innovation
summary: The policy outlines a communication strategy designed to support and promote start-ups, aiming to stimulate innovation across the economy. It focuses on outreach, messaging, and collaboration tactics to attract investment, talent, and resources to emerging businesses.

title: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups
summary: The EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups aims to give early‑stage companies in Europe access to high‑performance computing resources and support. It provides startups with HPC infrastructure, mentorship, and funding opportunities to accelerate their research and product development.

title: Slideshow: Webinar on Risk Management
